paragraphs: Rav Huna Zuta, in Rav Yosef’s time and in Rav Huna the Great’s time; for this reason they called him Zuta, “the lesser.” Or he is the unqualified Rav Huna, who was short (see his entry). I have not found Rav Huna Zuta except when his son Rabbah is mentioned: “Rabbah bar Huna Zuta” (see his entry). Perhaps it should read Rav Hamnuna Zuta (see his entry).
